lessons_used: Post-adoption/certificate sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won, while moving sign-in post-waiting hurt and sync hints/notices showed no clear effect.

Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and desktop spawn hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.

Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, multi-step quality inspection/fallback flows, guidelines banners, and stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts had no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., placement verification screens, interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step quality inspection flows).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Post-Adoption Certificate Step
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in screen to take place immediately after the adoption certificate stage rather than before photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off at 68.9%. Asking users to sign in after they have named and certified their companion captures post-creation momentum.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Post-adoption certificate sign-in timing was a proven winner, and sign_in reorder has a historical +3.1% lift.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Verification Stage Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated photo clarity verification screen between upload photos and adoption certificate to validate image rendering before pet creation.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple bug reports about custom pets failing or rendering incorrectly, causing abandonment during adoption (68.9% conversion).

new_photo_check.headline: Photo Quality Check
new_photo_check.body: Ensure your photo has good lighting and clear features for optimal pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adding a photo verification screen inside onboarding is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and support tickets, but multi-step inspection flows and fallback screens consistently hurt conversion.

candidates.title: Interactive Hatching Chamber Waiting Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout interactive hatching chamber with real-time progress indicators.
candidates.why: The waiting phase has an extreme mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), leading to user drop-off before reaching home.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Hatching
waiting.body: Your desktop companion is being crafted and prepared for your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while continuing to show the pet is being made is allowed under rule 2 and rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Interactive waiting rooms won in earlier tests, and home redesign shows a strong historical +5.6% lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Spawn Guided Stage
candidates.change: Transform the home intro screen into a stage-based onboarding flow that guides users step-by-step on how to locate, spawn, and control their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding pet visibility issues and confusion around controlling or hiding the desktop pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Learn how to position your pet, access quick controls, and customize interaction settings.

guard.reason: Expanding the home intro stage within onboarding is explicitly permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Supported by both funnel drop-off and support tickets; interactive spawn placement flows won in historical lessons with +6.2% lift.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Restoration Security Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and hint to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores missing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets
sign_in.hint: Use your existing account email to automatically recover your pet collection.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Path Outcome Time Expectation Hint
candidates.change: Add a informative hint under choose_path options stating estimated creation time for preset vs custom paths.
candidates.why: Choose path exhibits a high mean duration of 514s as users hesitate over path choices without clear expectations.

choose_path.hint: Preset path takes ~1 minute. Custom pet creation takes ~3 minutes.

guard.reason: text in 'choose_path.hint' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: Desktop Hatch Ready System Notification Prompt
candidates.change: Enable system readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when background rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting median duration is 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and forget to return.

waiting.hint: We'll notify your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you!

guard.reason: Adding ready notifications on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Notifications on the home/waiting screen showed no clear effect or slight negative results (-0.2% average).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward
candidates.change: Add an official guardian badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is the largest drop point in the funnel (68.9% conversion); adding a reward component increases delight and completion momentum.

guard.reason: Adding an official guardian badge to the certificate maintains the official stamp concept and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets the step with the highest drop-off (68.9%); adoption incentives historically yield a +2.8% lift.

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Readiness Time Indicator
candidates.change: Display active progress bars and estimated completion timer on the waiting room screen.
candidates.why: Users wait an average of 2336s on the waiting screen; visual readiness indicators reduce perceived wait time and bounce rates.

guard.reason: Displaying active progress and completion timers for real waits is permitted under rule 4 and rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Progress indicators and timers showed no clear effect in lessons, though home wait_info averages +1.8% over 9 tests.

candidates.title: Story Welcome Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Change the initial story intro screen to a two-column layout highlighting companion choices and setup overview side-by-side.
candidates.why: High mean time spent on choose_path/story (514s) indicates early engagement needs clearer structure.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Select a ready-made companion or bring your own pet to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving its job of introducing the pet is allowed under rule 2 and rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path step has relatively low drop-off (87% conversion); choose_path layout changes average +0.9% lift.

lessons_next: Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while sync hints and notices showed no clear effect.

Path selection: Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.

Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.

Adoption flow: Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and multi-step inspection or fallback flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.

Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).
